statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nasdaq-100 futures are strongly positive on broad Nvidia-led technology strength, but persistent failed-retracement NQ structure is not yet verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; the principal conditional risk concentration is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster through the first U.S. cash hour.
headline: Nvidia-led Nasdaq futures strength reaches the top of WATCH before U.S. data
body: Nasdaq-100 futures are around 1% higher before the U.S. releases, with Nvidia and multiple semiconductor and software names higher. Falling volatility and softer Treasury yields support the bid, but direct evidence of repeated failed NQ retracements remains incomplete.

forecast.analysis: Into U.S. midday, the baseline assumes more balanced rotations and less event pressure. Tail falls below WATCH unless NQ continues to hold extremes with unusually weak mean reversion.
The power-hour approach can reintroduce directional pressure. WATCH is conditional on renewed index-level extension rather than on technology leadership alone.
After the cash close, Marvell's scheduled semiconductor earnings call creates a new event window. Tail remains WATCH only if its reaction broadens into sustained index-level technology repricing.

During the Marvell call, Stress is high because semiconductor guidance can move the AI complex. Tail would require persistent NQ follow-through with shallow retracements, not merely a large single-name move.
Post-call risk should ease if semiconductor reactions fragment or retrace. Continued aligned chip strength with index-level extension would keep WATCH conditions in place.
Late evening should normalize if the Marvell reaction settles and cross-asset volatility remains contained. A fresh directional second leg would be the main invalidation.
Early Asia hours carry lower scheduled U.S. event intensity. The baseline is normal unless a delayed technology or geopolitical repricing produces sustained NQ extension.
Asian trading remains a low-event window. Tail stays low unless overnight price discovery becomes one-way and holds near extremes without meaningful retracement.
With no major scheduled U.S. catalyst in this hour, normal conditions are favored. A broad global technology continuation would matter only if it translates into persistent NQ structure.
Overnight event density remains light. Tail stays low unless a delayed second leg develops across NQ, semiconductors and major technology names.
Early European lead-in remains primarily a cross-asset confirmation window. Normal conditions persist unless yields, volatility and technology breadth align with a one-way NQ move.
European opening flows can raise noise without implying Tail. The baseline remains normal unless NQ extends directionally while retracements stay shallow.
Cross-market participation becomes more informative as Europe develops. Tail remains low unless technology strength broadens and NQ holds near extremes.
Later European trade begins the transition toward Friday's U.S. event calendar. Stress rises modestly, while Tail remains low absent persistent directional efficiency.
Friday's U.S. premarket approaches with Jackson Hole increasingly relevant. Tail remains low because the speech is still hours away; current structure would need fresh one-way confirmation.
Premarket positioning may become more sensitive to rate expectations. Stress rises, but Tail remains low unless NQ structure and cross-assets align directionally.
With the Jackson Hole keynote drawing closer, event sensitivity increases. The forecast remains conditional: a scheduled speech is not Tail evidence before price discovery occurs.
The final forecast hour carries elevated event sensitivity ahead of the 14:00 UTC Warsh keynote. Tail remains low unless pre-speech NQ develops persistent extension with weak retracements.

Cash-open risk turns orange only conditionally if NQ holds extremes through failed pullbacks with aligned technology breadth.
The first cash hour is the strongest continuation test; meaningful retracement would rapidly weaken the elevated Tail path.
